spans.s:
r. 4th cl. (ञि ईर ऊ) ञि ईरदृपु (दृप्यति)
1 To be glad, to rejoice.
2 To be arrogant, to be vain or proud.
r. 6th cl. (दृपति)
To pain, to inflict pain, to torture.
r. 1st and 10th cls. (दर्पति दर्पयति)
To light, to kindle or inflame.

mfn. (-प्तः-प्ता-प्तं)
Proud, arrogant.
E.
दृप to be proud, affix क्त.

mfn. (-प्यन्-प्यती-प्यत्)
Being proud or arrogant.
E.
दृप to be proud, शतृ aff.

mfn. (-प्रः-प्रा-प्रं)
1 Strong, powerful.
2 Proud, arrogant.
E.
दृप to be proud, Uṇādi affix रक्.
